groundContrastPolicy.measurement: Rec.709-weighted RGB luma on a 0–255 scale; overlays keep their existing contrast.
groundContrastPolicy.rule: Moderate lightening and desaturation per material, retaining its colour and depth. Keep a useful lift in forest, wetland, cave and tar floors without imposing a universal pale base.
groundContrastPolicy.desaturation: Each terrain proposal has RGB channel spread no greater than its current base; cool/olive hue preserves biome identity.
groundContrastPolicy.objectGuidance: Ground supports shaded interactables without looking washed out. Preserve object outlines, shadow planes and lit tops; the original chest and unchanged well are contrast references.
groundContrastPolicy.tuning: Retain 75% of the previous proposed RGB adjustment from the current base, reducing the lightening and desaturation together by approximately 25%.
